item.title: Spirit photography: how to make apparitions with an analogue camera
item.description: In the late 19th century, photography was proof that something had happened. At the height of the spiritualist movement, some photographers turned that trust into a business: they claimed they could photograph the dead alongside the living, and many grieving families paid for such an image. Most were frauds — some of those «spirits» turned out to be living people — but they all used the same tools: exposure time, double exposure and light. Exactly what film photography works with, what people today call analogue.
